Can You Buy Another Home After a Short Sale? | Central Texas Real Estate
A short sale doesn’t always mean homeownership is over forever.

Many homeowners are able to buy again depending on their loan type, finances, and recovery timeline.

The biggest mistake? Assuming there’s no path forward.
